description: This file contains utility functions for handling spatial data filters, including generating filters based on spatial types (latlong, delimited, geohash), calculating position bounds, and constructing cross-filter data masks for spatial data interactions in a mapping context.

methods.name: getFiltersBySpatialType
methods.description: Generates filters based on spatial data type (latlong, delimited, geohash) and input positions or bounds.

methods.name: calculatePickedPositionBounds
methods.description: Calculates spatial bounds around a picked coordinate considering viewport zoom level.

methods.name: getSpatialColumnLabel
methods.description: Returns a label for spatial columns based on available latitude, longitude, geohash, or line column.

methods.name: getStartEndSpatialFilters
methods.description: Creates spatial filters for start and end spatial data points based on picked data.

methods.name: isPointInBounds
methods.description: Checks if a point lies within specified spatial bounds.

methods.name: getSpatialFilters
methods.description: Generates spatial filters based on current data object, spatial configuration, and filter state.

methods.name: getLineColumnFilters
methods.description: Creates filters based on line or polygon path data.

methods.name: getGeojsonFilters
methods.description: Creates filters based on GeoJSON geometry coordinates.

methods.name: getCrossFilterDataMask
methods.description: Main function to generate cross-filter data mask for spatial data interactions, handling various spatial configurations.
